messages:
neha: heads-up: svc-c in ap-south started failing mutual TLS to svc-d around 03:12 UTC. TLS handshake aborts with "no shared cipher" on some pods, others ok.

liam: seeing same. Logs show proxy complaining about client cert chain validation: "no valid signing cert found" then KMS Verify errors when validating signatures.

rachel: i checked recent IAM/KMS changes: PR #5010 narrowed cmk-signing-key policy and removed role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/svc-c-signer. Could be related.

neha: excerpt from svc-d pod logs at 03:13:02: 
"cert_verify_error: chain_validation_failed cause=signature_validation KMSVerifyDenied principal=arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/svc-c-signer action=kms:Verify"

deploy-bot: deploy: PR "rbac/narrow-cmk-policy" merged by liam at 2026-03-23T02:05:12Z.

liam: that was me. I scoped the key policy to reduce blast radius. I didn't realize the signer agent used KMS Verify during handshake validation.

neha: immediate plan: 1) rollback the key-policy change to restore Verify for svc-c-signer; 2) restart affected signer agents/canaries; 3) enable an alert for KMS Verify denies > 0 in ap-south.

rachel: rolling back now and increasing CloudTrail retention for ap-south to 120d for audit. I'll also create a mapping of which services call KMS Verify vs Decrypt.

sec-bot: Incident SEC-2026-043 opened: mTLS client cert validation failures (KMS Verify denies) in ap-south.

liam: rollback applied. Verify-deny counts dropped to zero within 90s and handshakes recovered on canaries.

neha: follow-ups: - Update RBAC change checklist to require owners of KMS-key-using services sign off. - Add CI canary that simulates KMS denies for cert flows. - Enhance signer agent to cache & validate signing certs and to fail closed by default; optional operator flag to allow degraded validation in emergencies.

rachel: assigning owners: liam -> RBAC gating and PR process, neha -> signer-agent design + patch, rachel -> audit mapping and retention. Scheduling a 30m post-incident sync tomorrow. Thanks all. :lock:
